newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.800 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.800 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended November 9 was 4,800,256 gallons compared with 4,973,075 gallons last week.
Imports were 1,066,823 gallons compared with 1,293,720 gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled 43,359 gallons versus 216,630 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 1,224,792 gallons compared with 978,793 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 3,422,329 gallons versus 4,275,040 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 259,824,066 versus 259,396,146 a year ago.
Inventory was 46,368,397 versus 52,944,633 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
